title: Solid sphere hung by a ball joint at its top: period 4 sqrt(I_p / (m g d)) K(sin(theta0/2)) with I_p = 2/5 m r^2 + m r^2

tol.derivation: requirement: 1e-4 of the period at h = 0.5 ms; a wrong inertia moves it by >= 1e-2 (point mass: 2 pi sqrt(d/g) is 15% shorter)

residual_m.derivation: per substep gravity sags the anchor by g h^2 before the correction; the 1D projection along the error leaves at most the same again across it through the rotation coupling: 2 g h^2, doubled for rounding and the period-2 mode of the coupling
